Umba vatano po doije vasye ribuge intabo raijare umawe de po raura nanto akarije umawe ai pare, ‘Injae, syo naen winyamo naemeno vatane maije jewen. Vatano kaijinta wo anakere raijar, weramu winyamo nyo awa doije raija tenambe.
Weti ijaniv, ti syoroto syo doije vasye ribuge intabo nyo raunande umawe rangkokaibe no kopa ate. Ti Injae, nya doije mi so.’

Umba akarije umawe po raura nanto ai pare, ‘Winyamo vatano mamun muno nyononae ntapekan! Nyanapatambe rinai kobe jewen! Nyo inatantona nyare vatano kaijinta wo anakere raijar, weramu risyamo syo awa doije raija tenambe.

Maisyare omai ti, arono syo doije raunande nai, weamo syare nyo raugato ntami no yavaro doije ntuna raije rai, wirati indamu ama manuije miridije nseo. Inda arono syakare, syo doije umaso raugav muno ama seano miridije nseo ratavon.’
Weti akarije umawe po raura apa naite mai pare, ‘Wapo doije umawe raugavo vatane wato aora, yara wapo raunanto vatano apa doije vasye ribuge abusyine umawe amarom tavon.
Weye are pirati po sya ananuge raeranande kobe, opamo syo kove raunande ai ti manui. Yara are pirati po sya ananuge raeranande kobe jewen, opamo syo apa ananuge raugavo aora.
Muno syare vatano panapatambe kobe jewen wato pamo wapo amaugusyo kaumuro marane rai. No ratuije poyov tawan muno siuri tutir.’”
“Arono Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, syakare no mine vone so, weamo ride Sya kovo ntiti rautan, muno naito Amisye utavondi Rinai tenambe. Arono naije rituna no Sya kursijo titi rai indamu ibe akarive.
Umba Syo vatano mine tename so manugan bintabo no Rinamun. Umba Syo maosor maisyare vatane inta po domba nawe kambine nawe maosore wemaisy.
Syo domba mansaveto no inanem ngkov, yara Syo kambine maveto no inanem ngkakai. Domba maurata irati vatano utavondi Injayo Amisye apa bekere rai, yara kambine maurata irati vatano wonayo Ai.

Umba Risy, Akarijo Titi, syo raura nanto vatano una no inanem ngkove mai syare, ‘Wade, weapirati Sya Injaya po kove raugaje wasai. Wade wasisa irati Sya munijo ibe akarive raije rai, wemirati Syo ratayao ntuna mo wasanyut no arono mine so ama manasyin.
Weye arono rimaror, wapo anaisye raunande Syo raisy. Arono inawa ngkangkamandi, wapo mana raunande Syo ramanam. Arono ino no maran ti ide, wapo inaugave siso no wapa yavar.
Arono Sya ansune meweno Rinai, wapo ansune inta raunande Syo rave. Arono rigwanen, wade wapo inaeranande. Arono rimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai, wade wapo inapan.’

Umba vatano utavondi Amisye apa bekere raije umawe wo raura nande Rinai ware, ‘Amisyo winy, nanduija pi wimaror ti reamo anaisye raunande Nyo raisy muno nawa ngkangkamandi ti reamo mana raunande Nyo ramanam?
Nanduija pi reamo naen maisyare vatano no no maran ti de, weti reamo nauga siso no reama yavar? Nanduija pi Nya ansune meweno Nai weti reamo inta raunande Nyo rave?
Nanduija pi reamo naen winggwanen ndako, wimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai rako, weti reamore wamo napan?’
Umba Syo raura akananto mai syare, ‘Tugae, arono wapo ana umaso raunanto Sya arakovo awa tame maje rave mai, omamo maisyare wapo raunande Rinaije wemaisy.’

Umba Risy, Akarijo Titi umaso, syo raura nanto vatano una no inanem ngkakaije mai syare, ‘Wapuje inaora! Amisye apa mangke maje wasai! Wata wasisa no tanamo mbadururo nuge nuganuije rai, namirati ratayao Anakakai Akoe pe apa naite nawe mansai.
Weye arono rimaror, wapo anaisye inta raunande ti Syo raisye ramu. Arono inawa ngkangkamandi, wapo mana inta raunande Syo ramaname ramu.

Arono ino no maran ti ide, wapo inauga siso no wapa yavare ramu. Arono Sya ansune meweno Rinai, wapo ansune inta raunande Syo rave ramu. Arono rigwanen dako, rimakova no tanoano makova ama uga rai rako, weamo wapo inaeranande ramu.’

Umba wo raura nanto Rinai ware, ‘Amisyo winy, nanduija pirati reamo naeno maror muno nawa ngkangkamandi muno wino no maran ti nde muno Nya ansune meweno Nai muno winggwanen muno wimakova no tanoano makova rai, ti reamanapatambe Naije jewen?’
Umba Syo raura akananto mai syare, ‘Syo raura tugaive: arono waponayo wapo ana umaso raunanto Sya arakovo awa tame maje rave mai, omamo maisyare waponayo wapo raunande Rinaije wemaisy.’
Maisyare omai ti, indati vatano ukakainoanive umaso onawamo mangke nuge nuganuije raunanto mai, yara vatano utavondi Amisye apa bekere rai awave irati kovo nuge nuganuije rai.”
Arono Yesus po ayao umawe raurana mewen, umba Po raura nanto Apa arakovo utavondi aije mansai pare,
“Wadaen masyote rurum akato, umba wansisa Ono Paska rai. Arono naije vatane wo Arikainyo Vatane inaunanto indamu inauseo sawa inyo kapite rai.”
Umba syeno akokoe utantuna no Yavaro Amisye rai muno akarijo Yahudi wanunugambe no Syeno Titi Kayapas apa yavare ama uga.
Wanyinyaube indamu wo Yesus aijar muno wo aubaisy. Wo raura ware, “Wade wamo aijar maninimbe.
Weramu vemo wamo aijar no one ama uga so rai nora, weye vatano wanui indati upari ti usivuiny.”
Arono naije Yesus no no munijo Betania, tuna no Simon apa yavar, wepirati aravure mo ave no wusyinoe.
Umba wanya inta nde mo botoro nsasabe inta raugav ntairi jirati manino mbovove rai, ama mangke nseo rave. Arono Yesus pisyisy, wanya umawe mo manine umaso rauvaro akarije vone rai.
Arono Apa arakovo utavondi aije wo ana namije raen, upari. Weti wo raura ware, “Veanimaibe wanya so mbaono manino mbovove so rai ti mewen?
Manine so ama mangke nseo rave, weti kove mamo ramavun bayave umba ama doije raunanto vatano awa ananuge meweno maije mai.”
Weramu Yesus po raura mai pare, “Wabeanimaibe wapo wanya so raura ti ranimaumbe? Ama ana mo raijaro Rinai mamo ngko dave.
Vatano awa ananuge meweno maije onawamo una no wapa yasyine rai tutir, weti arono rui wapare wapo maeranande, weamo wapo maeranande kai. Weramu Risyamo rino no wapa yasyin tutire ramu.
Wanya so mo manine rauvaro Rinai indamu mo inanasine ratayao Sya masyoto inantuna raije rai.
Syo raura tugaive: mine vone so rui rui vayave vatane wo Ayao Kovo Amisye ravov, weamo wo wanya so ama ana ndave raura tavon indamu maemeno rai.”
Naije Yudas Iskariot, opamo Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane rurum utavondi aije inta pije, poroto no syeno akokoe mansai.
Umba po mansanajo pare, “Animaisye mi wapare wapo raunande rinai indamu syo Yesus augore no wasaneme uga rai?” Weti wo doije ratora nanto no vasye tenamara eane abusyin, umba wo raunanto ai.
Naije kobe Yudas po varore rakani indamu po Yesus amavun.

Naije Ono Paska ndea mamaisy, arono vatano Yahudi wo rotijo ragije mewen daije raisy. Arono ama masyoto manasyin, Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije ude Ai wo anajo ware, “Injae, rui rati nyare mbekero reamo anaisyo Paska ratayao Nai?”

Umba Po raura akananto mai pare, “Wasisa no Yerusalem, wapare wananta vatane inta ai, umba wapo raura ai wapare, ‘Injayo Kurune pare: Sya masyote ndea mamaisy, weti Risye Sya arakovo utavondi rinaije nawe reamare wamo Ono Paska rai no nya yavar.’”
Umba Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wuruta wo rave mamaisyo Apa ana daura rai, umba wo anaisyo Paska ratayao ti ntuna.
Naman kobe, umba Yesusa tuna apa arakovo abusyinara eane jirume matavon indamu wo anaisyo Paska raisy.
Arono wisyisy, naije Yesus po raura nanto mai pare, “Syo raura tugaive, weapamo indati inta nyo inamavun nanto Sya marova mansai.”
Apa arakovo utavondi aije wo ayao umaso ranaun ti manimaumbe rave. Umba nanentabo wo Yesus anajo rai, inta pare, “Injae, risya jewena rako?”
Umba Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Are pirati wepe ririmo rotije rayansundijo pauraije intabo rai, opirati po inamavun.

Tugae, Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, indati ikakai maisyare muno ratoe no Ayao Amisye rai. Weramu kakaije nde vatano po Arikainyo Vatane inamavune ai! Weti syare ngko dave mamo vatane wato ano jewen kai no mine vone so, weamo ngkovo ai weye indati mangke umaso nande aije ramu.”
Umba Yudas, napi po Yesus amavun, po anajo pare, “Injayo Kurune, risya jewena rako?” Umba Yesus po raura pare, “Winy, maisyare muno nyo raura omaisy ivae.”

Arono wo anaisye raisy, Yesus po rotije raijade umba Po kove raura seo Amisye ai. Umba Po raporadi muno Po ratodijo Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai, umba Po raura pare, “Wadaugav wadaisy, somamo inanasine mi som.”
Umba Yesus po mokijo anggurije raijade, umba Po kove raura seo Amisye ai. Umbawe Po raunanto mai, Po raura pare, “Watenambe wadamanam.
Somamo Sya mavugo nsororopo vatano wanuije mansai indamu awa ayao kakaije rapaya mai. Sya mavu mo Amisye apa urairijo wanyine raokaisy.
Syo raura wasai: indati Syo anggurije inta ramanam akatoe ramu gao Syo anggurijo wanyine ramanamo wasatavon arono Sya Injaya de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so.”
Umba ukinyo ansyerano ngkangkamane inta rai, umbawe wuruta kobe no Pukamo Saitun.

Umba naije Yesus po raura nanto Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai pare, “Namane so wapo inapaya ti ino ara wanajiv bintabo inaora. Maisyare Ayao Amisye mo ratoe mare, ‘Syo vatano po domba maeranandeye aubaisy, umba apa domba mandamisy ti unanajibe.’
Weramu arono indati ikovakato to, syakare syuisy ti Syo wasanyut no Galilea.”
Umba Petrus po raura nanto Ai pare, “Jewena! Arakovo kaijinta unanajibe kai, yara risyamo syo napaya ramu!”
Yesus po raura akananto ai pare, “Syo raura tugaive, namane so mangkuere pana kokebeve rainy, winyamo indati nyo inamamarave susye mandei.”
Umba Petrus po raura pare, “Ikakaijo Injae natavon kai, yara syo namamarave ramu!” Umba arakovo kaijinta wo raura tavonare wemaisy.

Naije Yesusa pe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe wanya unanta no nawaisyo wo rawaina ware Nawaisyo Getsemani. Umba Yesus po raura nanto Apa arakove mai pare, “Watantuna no naiso wapo inanyut, weye syare syoroto no ratuije ra ibe sambayambe rati.”
Umba Po Petrus awainde indamu tavondijo Ai, muno Po Yohanesa pe Yakobusa pe, onayamo Sebedeus apa arikainye naya, yawainde tavon. Naije Yesus animaumbe muno anuga nseo maje.
Po raura mai pare, “Inanuga mpatimu rave maisyare muno syare ikakai kobe vayave wemaisy. Wano no so muno wagwarano inatavon.”

Yesus poroto gwaravaindi, umba Po apa vukane ranteter no kopa umba be sambayambe pare, “Sya Injae, wimayar, syare Nyo siurije so raveto inaora. Weramu vemo wintavono Sya bekere rai nora, yara Injae nya bekere bo rai.”
Naije umba Yesus pakare po Apa arakove mandeije umawe maen unaki. Ti Po raura Petrus ai pare, “Risambayambe uma amije intabo vayave, weramu wagwaran inatavone ramu!
Syare wagwaran muno wasambayambe indamu vemo ana mo wasatopane mo wasakep inya! Tugae, wasanuga mbeker, weramu wasanasino kopa mayondi.”
Naije akato Yesus pakato be sambayambe akato pare, “Sya Injayo Winy, ranivara siurijo inanto raije so raveto inaora kakai, weamo syare Injae wibuinya bekere mamaisy.”
Arono pakare akato no Apa arakovo mandeije umawe mai, naije Po maen unakija akatoa nene weye mamije maomon dave.
Weti pakato be sambayambe akatove mandei, Po raura maisyare umawe maisy akato.

Umba pakare akato no Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai, Po raura mai pare, “Wabeanimaibe wanakija nene? Inya! Sya uma amije ndea mamai to, ti soamo Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, inaunanto no vatano mamune mansai.
Wasea, wade ra wanta! Waperata, vatano po inamavune dea pararai to!”

Arono Yesus payaowa nene, naije Yudas de. Opamo Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane rurum inta pije. Vatano wanui wo omake muno kaije raugav utavono Yudas ai. Onawamo syeno akokoe nawe, akarijo Yahudi nawe wo matutir.
Yudas pare po Yesus amavun, weti po raura wusyimbe irati vatano wanuije umaso mai pare, “Vatano rui pirati syare syo anu, Wepamo napije.”
Naije Yudas de nande kobe Yesus ai umba po raura pare, “Injayo Kurune, namane ngkovo nai!” Umba po anu.
Umba Yesus po raura nanto ai pare, “Arakove, animaisye mi winde ra nyo rave, weamo nyo rave kai.” Umba vatano wanui utavondi Yudas aije wiridije ude kobe wo Yesus aijar.
Umba naije Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije inta po apa omake rapatin no ama kokome rai, umba po rave vatano panapatambe syeno titi aije amarikoame raotar ti mpatimu.

Umba Yesus po raura nanto Apa arakovo utavondi aije umaso ai pare, “Nya omake ramawe akasyo no ama kokome rai, weye are pi pare po omake veano vatane inta aperam, weamo indati vatano kaijinta wo aubaisyo omake rai jakato.
Syare weananta rai: ranivara Syo sya Injaya anajo ratire, wea indati pavave Po apa naite ribuge wanui rave matutir ude indamu uno inaorai kobe.
Weramu jewen kai, weye ana nande somamo nande indamu mamaisyo Ayao Amisye mo raurairive wusyimbe rai.”

Umba Yesus po raura vatano wanuije umawe mai pare, “Risyamo vatano mamune inta pi Risye ramu. Ti wabeanimaibe wade irati omake muno kaije rautan indamu wapo inaijar? Masyote anteter rituna syananyaube no Yavaro Amisye ama uga, weramu wapo inaijare ramu.
Weramu ana so nande indamu mamaisyo urairijo anawae wo ratoe no Ayao Amisye raije rai.” Naije kobe Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wo apaya ti no ara unajita aora.
Vatano wo Yesus aijar wo auga ti usisa no Syeno Titi Kayapas apa yavare rai. Naije kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa raije nawe, akarijo Yahudije nawe, wanugan tenambe.
Petrus po Yesus arijabe ti de siso no syeno titi apa yavare ama wanijate rai. Umba tuna syeno titi apa naite inta matavon indamu po animaisye mi akari akokoe Yahudi wo rapatimugo Yesus aije raen.
Syeno akokoe muno Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi wo vatano wayao angkarive irati Yesus aije mawainde indamu wo aura tantunawi no mansamun, weye ware wo mangke raugaje Ai inda kakai.
Vatano wanuije inta nawi ude wayao angkarive vayave, weramu awa ayaowe mamaisye ramu. Umba vatane jiruma syayai no mansamun.
Yo raura yare, “Vatane wato pi po raura pare, ‘Risyamo sya vambunine mamaisyo Syo Yavaro Amisy randamisy, masyote mandei umba Syo raijar akaeyo ntet akato.’”
Umba syeno titi seo tet, po raura nanto Yesus ai pare, “Mbeanimaibe irati Nyo ana yo raura nande Naije so raura akanande reansaije jewen?”
Weramu Yesus manin bayave. Umba syeno titi po raura Ai pare, “Syo nanajo Amisyo noa pitawabe Apa tame rai indamu Nyo raura kakavimbe reansai: Winyamo Mesias, Arikainyo Amisye, pi Win dako?”

Yesus po raura nanto ai pare, “Sya tamo ndanajo mi taune windaura to, ti syare tugae, Risy ivae. Muno Syo raura wasai syare: masyoto makareye indati wapo Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, inaen ituna no Amisyo Bambunin Dave anem ngkove rai. Muno wapo inaen rino kamuro popere rai no naumo warae ti syaje.”

Arono syeno titi po Yesus apa ayao umaso ranaun, naije pari rave weti po taune apa ansune rasajam umba po raura pare, “Ee! Vatane so pare po Amisyo no no munijo ntiti amaisy! Weti vemo wamo vatano kaijo wo aura tantunawi mawainde akato nora. Weapamo wasamarikoame mo ranaun to: Taune Po apa ayao kakaije raurawa wadanaun to, pare Opamo po Amisye amaisy!
Ti wapare?” Umba akari akokoe Yahudi wo raura akananto ware, “Reamare wamo mangke raugaje Ai indamu kakai.”
Naije vatane inta wo Yesus amune ranyipube. Muno inta wo anepat, inta wo apoam.
Umba wo raura nanto Ai ware, “Ranivara Winyamo Mesias wepi Winy, weamo Nyo vatano po nanepate so apa tame raura kakavimbe reansai!”
Arono naije Petrus tuna no yavare umawe ama wanijate rai, umba wanya arikainyo manapatambe syeno titi aije inta nde mo raura nanto Petrus ai mare, “Winyirati ntavono Yesus vatano Galilea aive tavon.”
Weramu Petrus po Yesus amamarave no vatane umawe mansamun pare, “Syantukambe nya ana ndaura so rai!”

Umba Petrus poroto te no unsanda wanijate. Naije wanya manapatambe kaijinta mo aen akato, umba mo raura nanto vatano una no naije mansai mare, “Vatane sopamo tavondive Yesus vatano Nasaret ai tavone pa.”
Weramu Petrus po Yesus amamarave akato muno pare, “Tugae rave, syantukambe vatane wato ai!”
Nugoenta rainya umba vatano usai no we wo raura nanto Petrus ai ware, “Nanamote wato mamo maisyare vatano Galilea, ti tugae winyamo vatano tavono Yesus aije inta pi winy.”
Umba Petrus panaamatambe muno po raura pare, “Risyamo syantukambe vatane wato Ai!” Naije kobe mangkuere kokebe.
Umba Petrus aemeno Yesus apa ana daura rai pare, “Mangkuere kokebe rainy, indati nyo inamamarave susye mandei.” Umba Petrus puje poyo dave.
Awatan ngko dave syeno akokoe nawe, akarijo Yahudi nawe wanugan tenambe, wayao wo rapatimu indamu wo Yesus aubaisy.
Weti wo Yesus aokaisy, umba wo augaveta wo aunanto no Gubernur Pilatus ai.

Arono Yudas, opi po Yesus amavun, po raen wo mangke raugaje Yesus ai, naije animaumbe ti po doije vasye tenamara eane abusyin umawe raugakare po raunanto syeno akokoe nawe akarijo Yahudi nawe mansai jakato.

Po raura mai pare, “Risyamo ayao kakaijo syo rave manakoe rave, weye syo vatano ayao kakaije meweno aije amavun ti aubaisy.” Weramu wo raura nanto ai ware, “Soamo nyayao daijamo taune winy! Reamo naranive ramu, yara taune winya ana ndave ma, weti taune winyi nyo ranawan!”
Weti Yudas po doije umaso raugaveto po ramau siso no Yavaro Amisye ama uga umba poroto po taune apui ti sawa ti kakai.

Umba syeno akokoe wo doije umawe ranugan, umba wo raura ware, “Doije somamo doijo veano vatane amavun ti aubaisy, weti wama ananyao inta mo raorai mare vemo rator siso doijo raugasya no bayaijo ntuna no Yavaro Amisye ama uga ratavon inya.”
Weti wayao ti wo rapatimu ware wo doije umaso veano anoke inta ramavun indamu vatano marane mantuna rai. Anoke umaso ama tame rawainamo “vatano po anomane ranari apa anoke mije.”
Weti wo doije umawe veano ramavun, wemi mbewar anoke umaso rawain akato no naiso ama tame mi Kopa Mavu.
Ana umaso nande indamu mamaisyo Amisye apa ayao wemirati anawae Yeremia po raura rai pare, “Arono vatano Israel wo Vatane umaso amavun, ware Apa mangke mi doije vasye tenamara eane abusyin.
Ti umba wo doije umaso veano vatano po anomane ranari apa anoke ramavun, maisyare muno Amisye po inaura raije wemaisy.”

Yesus pamo te no Gubernur Pilatus amun. Naije Pilatus po anajo pare, “Winyirati Akarijo Titi Yahudije pi Win dako?” Umba Yesus po raura akananto ai pare, “Risy ivae, mamaisyo nya ana ndaura wato rai.”
Umba syeno akokoe muno akarijo Yahudi wo ayao kakai rantutibe Ai, weramu Po ana inta raura nakananto maije ramu.
Pilatus po anajo akato pare, “Mbeanimaibe irati Nyo raura akananto mansaije jewen? Nyo raen wo naura tantunawi rave!”
Weramu Yesus po ayao inta raura akananto aije ramu, ti Gubernur Pilatus nantoive Ai.
Arono Ono Paska ndea mamaisy, gubernur apa ana po ravevea nsiridi to mamo po vatano tuna no tanoano makova raije inta apaya irati apa mangke rai, vatano rui pirati vatano wanuije wo apatimu.
Arono naije vatane inta apa tame mi Barabas tuna no tanoano makova rai. Vatane wo aen tenambe weye apa ana dave ngkakai rave.
Weti arono vatano wanuije wanugan, weamo Pilatus po manajo pare, “Are pirati wapare syo apaya wasai? Barabasa dako, Yesus wepirati awaino Mesias we dako?”
Pilatus po raenamo akarijo Yahudi wo Yesus aunanto ai weye manuga mamuno Yesus ai weye vatano wanui manayanambe Ai.

Arono Pilatus tuna no kursijo titi rai indamu po mangke rapatimu, naije tavon apa anamu mo nyovara wao inta raude ai mare, “Vemo nyo vatano ayao kakaije meweno aije wato ave tatugadi jinya, weye namanoe inikimarive sya nikimarijo idaenoe mo inavea ijani dave.”
Weramu syeno akokoe nawe akarijo Yahudi nawe awa ayao nsiso vatano wanuije mai indamu wo Pilatus anajo indamu po Barabas apaya mai, yara po mangke raugaje Yesus ai indamu kakai.
Weti arono Gubernur Pilatus po manajo pare, “Vatane jirume sonayamo wapare are pi syo apaya wasai?” naije vatano wanui wo raura ware, “Barabas!”
Umba po manajo akato pare, “Maisyare omai ti, animaisye mirati syo rave Yesus wepirati awaino Mesias ai?” Umba ugwain tenambe ware, “Auseo sawa inyo kapite rai!”
Umba Pilatus po manajo pare, “Weramu ayao kakaije rui mirati Po rave?” Umba vatano wanuije ugwain akoeve akato ware, “Auseo sawa inyo kapite rai!”

Pilatus po raen apa ana po raura vatano wanuije mansai umaso mamo po raurawa marudija, yara onawamo ware ubera usasivuiny. Weti po mana inta raugav po veano aneme rarondomo vatano wanuije umawe mansamun, umba po raura nanto mai pare, “Wapare wapo mangke raugaje Vatane so ai indamu kakai, weti syo inaneme rarondom indamu wapo raen ritavondi wasai jewen, yara Apa kakaije mamo taune wapa ana wadave ma!”
Umba vatan tenambe wo raura akanande ai ware, “Reame reama arikainye nawe reamo mangkeo Vatane so apa kakaije ranawan kai.”
Umba Pilatus po Barabas apaya mansai. Yara po naite inta matutir indamu wo kaijo waije rave Yesus anepat, umba po aunanto mai indamu wo auseo sawa inyo kapite rai.
Gubernur Pilatus apa naite inta wo Yesus augave siso no apa yavar. Umba wo awa arakovo naite mawainde wanugan tenambe Yesus akiani indamu wanaikebe Ai muno wo ambaon.
Wo Yesus apa ansuno no anakea raije raugaje umba wo ansuno nsintair manawadi inta raugasyo Ai ti po rave, maisyare akarijo titi inta po rave ramaisy.

Muno wo anansinao maisyare wanyavi ramaisy rauseo rakariwaibe akari rai, muno wo isyoe raunanto Po raijaro anem ngkove rai, maisyare akarijo titi po rave ramaisy. Umba wo vukane ranteter no Amun, muno wanaikebe Ai ware, “Winyirati Akarijo Titi Yahudi pi Winy!”
Umba wo anyipube, muno wo isyoe umawe raugav akato veano akarije ranepati tutir.
Wanaikebe Aija jewen, umba wo ansuno nsintaire umawe raugaje aora umba wo taune Apa ansune raugasyo Ai ti po rave akato. Naije umba wo auga ti wusya indamu wo auseo sawa inyo kapite rai.
Wanyana unanuije ama yasyin, unanta irati vatano Kirene inta ai, apa tame mi Simon. Umba wo antitidi indamu po Yesus apa inyo kapite ranawan.
Umba unanta no pukame inta rai, ama tame mirati raura ayao Yahudi raijamo Golgota, ama ine mare Akari Pae.
Umba wo anggurije raugav, manino parimane mo rakokoive, wo raunanto Yesus ai indamu Po ramanam. Po kavinta rausuv mamaumbe, weramu ponae Po ramanami.
Umba arono naite wo auseo sawa inyo kapite raija jewen, wo aikarae rapatin indamu wo Apa ansune ratodijo taune mansai.
Umba utantuna wo aman.
Ayao wo rave Yesus akekebe wemirati wo ratoe wo rauseo no inyo kapite ama von no taiso: Sopamo Akarijo Titi Yahudi.
Umba wo vatano mamune jiruma yauseo syawa Yesus atavon, inta sawa no anem ngkov muno inta sawa no anem ngkakai.
Vatano udetave so wo Yesus aen, makarije rangkiki seo Ai muno wo akaajian.

Ware, “Winyirati nandija nyare Nyo Yavaro Amisye randamisy yara masyote mandei Nyo rauseo ntet akato. Weti ranivara Winyamo Arikainyo Amisye pi Winy, weamo nyaje inyo kapite wato raora indamu Nyo nanasine rapaya kakaije rai.”
Maisyare wemai tavon syeno akokoe nawe, kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa raije nawe, akarijo Yahudi nawe wanaikebe Yesus ai.

Ware, “Opamo po vatano kaijinta mapaya kakaije rai, yara taune anasine mamo Po rapaya rai kakai! Po raurave pare opamo Akarijo Titi Israel pije! Weti ranivara paje inyo kapite wato raora, wea indati wamanave Ai.
Opamo panave Amisye ai muno Po raura pare, ‘Risyamo Arikainyo Amisye pi Risy.’ Weti ranivara Amisye anayanambe Ai, weamo kove mamo Po apaya kakaije so rai!”
Umba vatano mamune jiruma yausea syawa atavone yo Yesus akaajian tavon.
Masyote yasyin dave, uma ami abusyinara eane jirum, ananamane nande ntamijo munijo we rai tenambe yava uma amije mandei umba ngkarimu.
Uma amije mandei umba Yesus gwain akoeve, po raura ayao Yahudi rai pare, “Eli, Eli, lama sabakhtani?” ama ine mare, “Sya Amisye, Sya Amisye, mbeanimaibe irati nakirive Inai?”
Vatane inta una no naije wo Apa ayaowe umaso ranaun, umba wo raura ware, “Wadanita, Po anawae Elia awain!”
Vatano no no awa yasyine inta pavave poroto po maimare raugavere umba po raugasya rayansundijo anggurijo nsaisyine rai. Umba po ransuisyo uvi rai, po rareanseo no Yesus awa rai indamu Po rausuv.
Weramu vatano kaijinta wo raura ware, “Wade ra wamo aen dati, indati Elia de po apaya kakaije rai jaje rako jewena e?”
Naije Yesus gwain akoeve akato, umba anawayo karimu, kakai kobe.
Naije kobe kaene nsawa unsanda Yavaro Amisye ama Tanoano Ndandini Dave raije mamo nsaram no vone warae masyo no ate waraya mbe rurumbe. Mungki ravari ti orame mpaporainy.
Muno aipapo mpaporainy umba vatano wanui wanave Amisye ai no wusyinoe mansanasine ngkovakato.
Vatano ugwenene umaso wuje awa aipapo umaso raora arono Yesus kovakato, umba usisa no Yerusalem ti vatane wanui wo maen.
Arono nait akari Roma pe, apa naito nanawirati wo Yesus amane nawe, wo mungkije muno anakotaro nande umawe raen, umba ujani dave, ware, “Tugae rave, sopamo Arikainyo Amisye pi sop.”
Naijeamo wanya wanuije inta wo ana umawe raerato waravaimbe. Onawamo utavondijo Yesus ai muno wanapatambe Ai no Apa unanui anya rai no arono puje Galilea raora.
No awa yasyine umasoamo Maria Magdalena, muno Maria kaijinta, omamo Yakobusa pe Yusupa pe aya akoya, muno Sebedeus apa arikainye aya akoya me nao.
Masyote ndea mare ngkaumu kobe, umba vatano apa ananuge manui rave inta de, apa tame mi Yusup, no no munijo Arimatea. Opamo vatano tavondijo Yesus ai tavon.
Vatane umaso de no Pilatusa nui indamu po Yesus anasino kopa ranajo. Umba Pilatus po apa naite matutir indamu wo Yesus anasino kopa raugaje wo raunanto ai.
Weti Yusup po Yesus anasino kopa raugav, umba po ansuno mpopero nsauman veano akepan.
Umba po antuna no taune apa aipapo wanyino oramo ratotove rai. Po oramo manakoe inta raroya usya ntuna aipapo ama unsanda raora, umba poroto.
Maria Magdalena me, Maria kaijinta me, jantuna yamumbe nanto aipapo umaso ama unsanda rai.
Simambe, masyoto sambaya rai, umba syeno akokoe nawe vatano Parisije nawe wanugan usisa usai no Pilatus amun.
Umba wo raura ware, “Injae, reansaemen arono Yesus ta noa nene Po vatane maponae Po raura pare indati masyote mandei, weamo Opamo kovakato no wene rai.

Maisyare omai ti, reamare nyo naite matutir indamu wuruta wo aipapo ama unsanda raman. Vemo Apa arakovo utavondi aije inta ude wanaonoambe anasino kopa rai nora muno wo raura vatane mai ware Yesus kovakato no wene rai to, wenora! Weye ranivara wo raura tai maisy, wea indati awa angkarijo wo raura rijabe manakoe rave.”
Umba Pilatus po raura akananto mai pare, “Wapa naite nawi so, weti wata wapo aipapo ama unsanda raman kobe rave.”
Weti wuruta wo kamane raunanto ama unsanda rai indamu vemo vatane inta po ransop usya nora, umba wo raura nanto naite umawe mai ware, “Wapo raman kobe rave yo!”
Arono masyoto sambaya mewen ti ari Minggu ama awatan ngko dave akane ntipu, naije Maria Magdalena me, Maria kaijinta me yurija yo Yesus apa aipapo raen.
Kavuratawe mungkijo akoe inta ravari, weye naito Amisye inta no no munijo ntiti paje, umba de po oramo unsanda aipapo umawe raroyar umba seo tuna ama vone rai.
Naito Amisye umaso ba dave, maisyare ivake wemaisy, muno apa ansune mamo mpope dave.
Naito wo aipapo ramane umawe ujani dave ti ututar, umba mamune ngkaumudi ti utatayaje utavai no min, maisyare vatano ukakai to mansamaisy.
Umba naito Amisye umawe po raura nanto wanya umawe yai pare, “Vemo ijaniv inya. Syo raen ipo Yesus akani, Wepirati auseo sawa inyo kapite rai to.
Soamo norije ramu, yara kovakato to maisyare arono wusyinara Po raurave wemai to. Weti ide ipo Apa aipapo tami raije raeni so.

Weti ipavave ipakata ipo raura Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai ipare, ‘Soamo Yesus kovakato no wene rai to! Opamo puisya to no Galilea rai to. Ti wata no ratuije umba wapo aen.’ Syare isaemeno sya ana syo raura so rai.”
Wanya umaso yavave yo aipapo rapaya ti no. Onayamo ijani dave weramu yanayanambe rave tavon, weti yansanan yakare indamu yo raura Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije mai.
Kavuratawe Yesus nande wanya umaso yai, Po raura pare, “Awatane ngkovo isai.” Umba je yararaijo Ai, yo vukane ranteter no Amun muno yo ajoe raijar indamu ibeaje Ai.
Umba Yesus po raura nande yai pare, “Ijaniv inya, yara ipakata ipo raura Sya arakove mai inda wuruta no Galilea, umba wo inaen no ratuije.”
Wanya umaso ija to, umba naito wo aipapo ramane umawe inta wakare no Yerusalem, wo anakotaro nande tenambe umaso raura syeno akokoe mansai.
Weti syeno akokoe nawe akarijo Yahudi nawe wanugan indamu wayao rai. Umba wo rapatimu ware wo doijo manui raunanto naite umawe mansai indamu vemo wo Yesus apa kovakatoe raura inya.
Weti wo raura naite umawe mai ware, “Reamare wapo raura no taiso wapare, ‘Ama namanoe Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije ude wo Yesus anasine ranaonoambe no arono reanaki.’
Ranivara Gubernur Pilatus po ana umaso ranaun ti parijo wasai pare wapo Apa aipapo raman kobe jewen, weamo indati reamo gubernur anuga raugabe indamu vemo po mangke raugaje wasai jinya.”
Weti naite umawe wo doijo uma wo raunandeowe raugav, umba ubeta awa ana wo matutiro raije rarijati. Weti wo ayao Yesus anasine ranaonoambeye umaso ravovo vatano Yahudi mansaija ndea unumeso.
Weti Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane intabo utavondi aije wuruta no Galilea, umba usea unato uma Yesus po matutir uta raijoe rai.
Umba wo aen no ratuije, weti wo vukane ranteter no Amun muno ubeaje Ai, weramu inta nawamo manuga mamaundive Ai weye wanave kobe jewen.
Umba Yesus de pararaijo mai, Po raura nanto mai pare, “Injayo Amisye po vambunine raunande Rinai indamu ibe akarive no munijo ntiti muno mine vone so rai tenambe vintabo.

Maisyare omai ti, Syo wasatutir wata no rui rui vayave indamu wapo vatane kotaro ntuna no mine so rai mansanyao tenambe indamu utavondijo Rinai. Muno wapo maugasyo kuvuni mana raijo Injayo Amisye apa tame rai muno Apa Kavo tame rai muno Anawayo Vambunine ama tame rai.
Muno wapo manyao indamu ubeta Sya ananyao syo raugaje wasai to rai tenambe. Tugae rave, ituna wasautan tutira ntoa munije ama akari.”
